newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hokkaido Elec plant unaffected by acid tank blast.
newsitem.headline: Hokkaido Elec plant unaffected by acid tank blast.

text.p: Hokkaido Electric Power Co Inc said on Thursday that its 350,000-kilowatt (kw) Shiriuchi thermal power plant was operating normally despite a minor explosion in a tank holding hydrochloric acid.
"We are continuing normal operations," a company spokesman said.
He said it was not immediately clear what had caused the acid in the compound's tank to react.
Three workers who were cleaning the surface of the tank at the time were taken to hospital for treatment of eye irritation, the spokesman said.
The plant which is powered by crude oil is located in southwest Hokkaido, northern Japan.
